review_scope: Independent row arithmetic and result interpretation; reviewer did not author comparator/exporter, reviewed current design and authored prior KeyHistory specification. This is not independent experiment design or a native execution audit.

supported: At the same selected coadapted KeyOnly checkpoints, replacing past K content with current K while preserving the available coefficient sum decreases whole RMSE and increases whole MAE for all3 seeds in both Train/Validation and both weighting schemes.
Tail quantity RMSE and MAE improve in all6 seed/split cohorts; whole and tail TimeNLL worsen in all6. Mean signed shifts are positive in all12 whole seed/split/weight records.

The RMSE/MAE conflict is still present when available tap sum is held fixed; attributing the earlier deletion conflict solely to coefficient-sum change is unsupported. This does not isolate magnitude, direction, attention or memory competition.
not_established: Actual event-key norm/direction and attention are not invariant. DC response preservation is not raw-quantity-level preservation.
No conclusion that past history is generally harmful, that a particular constraint/gate/filter will improve both metrics, or that fixed-model off will outperform after retraining.
Old deletion-minus-on and new content-minus-on errors are nonlinear outcomes; their difference is not an additive causal decomposition.
A same_sign/high Validation row-weight mean benefit is not a consistent seed/split/two-weight selector; no post hoc input gate follows.
interpretation.remaining_gap: A specific implementable CNN mechanism with a priori reason to retain the observed MAE/time utility while reducing the RMSE/tail cost has not been identified. The present stored output contrasts do not identify which key-direction/norm/attention interaction supplies that utility.
interpretation.decision: Do not automatically select a new fit or rename an existing method. Preserve the bounded diagnostic conclusion. No further DC/deletion/content-removal probe or arbitrary strength sweep is recommended. Any future training contract requires a distinct structural rationale and matched counterfactual beyond these observed tradeoffs.

duplicate_risks.LevelHistoryQKV: Level/difference with confidence and QK constraints already exists; decomposition alone is not new.
duplicate_risks.V_difference: Adjacent zero-sum difference was already tested in V; moving to K is not automatically a justified constraint.
duplicate_risks.AdaptiveHistoryCNN: History-dependent tap reweighting was tested; high-change subgroup averages alone do not justify another gate.
duplicate_risks.MultiLagDetail: Multi-range level/detail branch already exists; present contrast does not establish a longer-history requirement.
duplicate_risks.QueryOnly_KeyOnly_QKOnly: Linear local-filter placement/removal has already been tested; this diagnostic is not a fresh architecture comparison.
duplicate_risks.free3tap: Rewriting free3tap into level and difference terms preserves its function class absent an independently justified constraint; function equivalence is not optimizer equivalence.
